book.name: 1 TESALONICENSES
book.title: Li Xbe̱n Hu li Quixtz'i̱ba li San Pablo reheb laj Tesalónica

content: Xban a'an nak k'axal takaj raj rabinquil e̱resil. Inc'a' chic xkacuy roybeninquil. Jo'can nak la̱o xocana arin Atenas kajunes.

Ut xkatakla li hermano Timoteo e̱riq'uin. A'an laj c'anjel chiru li Dios chixyebal resil li colba-ib sa' xc'aba' li Cristo. Laj Timoteo tixq'ue xcacuilal e̱ch'o̱l sa' le̱ pa̱ba̱l ut tixq'ue ajcui' e̱na'leb.
Inc'a' nakaj nak ta̱ch'ina̱k e̱ch'o̱l xban li raylal a'in. La̱ex nequenau nak takac'ul li raylal.
Nak toj cuanco chak sa' e̱ya̱nk xkaye resil e̱re nak takac'ul li raylal la̱o aj pa̱banel. Ac nequenau la̱ex nak jo'can quic'ulman.

Jo'can nak xintakla laj Timoteo e̱riq'uin xban nak inc'a' chic xincuy roybeninquil resil chanru cuanquex sa' le̱ pa̱ba̱l. Ma̱re anchal xex-a̱le̱c xban laj tza ut li kac'anjel ma̱re chicana̱k chi ma̱c'a' rajbal.

Toje' xsuk'i chak laj Timoteo e̱riq'uin ut a'an xc'am chak jun cha̱bil esilal che̱rix chanru nak cau e̱ch'o̱l sa' le̱ pa̱ba̱l ut chanru nak nequexrahoc. Ut xye ajcui' ke nak rajlal nocoe̱c'oxla jo' ajcui' nak nequexkac'oxla la̱o. La̱ex nequeraj rilbal ku ut jo'can ajcui' la̱o nakaj rilbal e̱ru la̱ex.
Riq'uin a'in, ex herma̱n, sa' chixjunil li raylal li yo̱co chixc'ulbal, nac'ojla kach'o̱l chirabinquil nak cau e̱ch'o̱l sa' le̱ pa̱ba̱l.
Ut anakcuan naru chic tocua̱nk chi sa sa' kach'o̱l xban nak nakanau nak cau e̱ch'o̱l sa' e̱pa̱ba̱l sa' xc'aba' li Jesucristo.
Inc'a' nakatau chanru nak takabantioxi chiru li Dios riq'uin lix sahil li kach'o̱l nequeq'ue ke sa' xc'aba' le̱ pa̱ba̱l. Li Dios naxnau nak c'ajo' xsahil li kach'o̱l e̱ban la̱ex.
Chi k'ek chi cutan nakatz'a̱ma chiru li Dios nak takil cui'chic e̱ru re nak takaq'ue xcacuilal e̱ch'o̱l sa' le̱ pa̱ba̱l.
A' taxak li Dios li kaYucua' ut a' taxak li Ka̱cua' Jesucristo chitenk'a̱nk ke re nak ta̱ru̱k toxic cui'chic e̱riq'uin.
A' taxak li Ka̱cua' chitenk'a̱nk e̱re re nak te̱ra e̱rib che̱ribil e̱rib ut chi anchal e̱ch'o̱l cherahak taxak le̱ ras e̱ri̱tz'in jo' nak nequexkara la̱ex.
A' taxak li Dios li kaYucua' chiq'uehok xcacuil e̱ch'o̱l. Tz'akalak taxak re ru le̱ pa̱ba̱l. Ma̱c'a'ak taxak e̱ma̱c chiru li Dios nak ta̱cha̱lk li Jesucristo rochbeneb li ac colbileb.
